name: Plain claims
description: Example lint pack: flags superlatives and absolute promises in captions and on-screen text, and keeps captions inside a length.
author: Nordle
disclaimer: Example rules to show the pack format. They are a writing aid, not legal advice. Check the rules that apply to your industry and country.

rules.message: Superlatives are hard to back up. Say what is specific and true instead.
Do not promise outcomes you cannot guarantee.
Several exclamation marks in a row read as shouting.
Caption is long. Most readers stop early.
